name: amazon-asin-monitor
description: Deploy, run, schedule, and audit a multi-market Amazon ASIN frontend monitor.

interface.longDescription: Runs and audits Amazon ASIN frontend checks for US, UK, DE, AU, and FR, including Buy Box, localized prices, variation relationships, rankings, screenshots, and Excel reports.
defaultPrompt: 使用 amazon-asin-monitor 运行 Amazon ASIN 前台巡检。
使用 amazon-asin-monitor 检查当前脚本和输出是否合规。
使用 amazon-asin-monitor 部署或升级巡检工作流。
